payload.claim: This new test recreates a bare repo with `subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", str(origin)], check=True)` instead of calling the `_bare` helper this same diff adds to `tests/conftest.py` for exactly this purpose. The repo already has a precedent for importing shared test helpers from conftest (`from tests.conftest import HostToolExecInTest` in test_cli.py), so this restates rather than reuses a helper the diff itself just centralized.
